verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated writing-skills meta-skill that walks an agent through authoring a new skill test-first: write pressure-scenario tests, watch them fail, write the SKILL.md, watch them pass, then refactor. It also documents where skills live (including the cross-runtime ~/.agents/skills/ alias). Separately, a runtime probe confirmed that skills are plain markdown folders with frontmatter that install cleanly, and an evals harness judges skill compliance. Missing for 10: explicit packaging/publishing steps for a newly authored skill (e.g. adding it to a plugin or marketplace manifest), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent authoring a skill end to end via the meta-skill.
